settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Every piece is printed when you order it and ships in 5 days. Taxes and shipping are calculated at checkout.

Misprints and defects are replaced free: send a photo within 30 days of delivery. Printed-to-order items can’t be returned or exchanged for size, so check the size guide first.
